import subprocess
from subprocess import run as sh

NO_WINDOW = {"creationflags": 0x08000000}
subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-version"])
subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-version"], creationflags=0x08000000)
subprocess.Popen(
    ["git", "status"],
    **NO_WINDOW,
)
sh(["git", "log"])
# subprocess.run(["in-a-comment"]) is not a call
subprocess.run(["a"], **cc.NO_WINDOW)  # module-qualified kwargs: not flagged
